title: Fire in the Lower Town
text: A chandler's shop went up at midnight and the wind did the rest. Three streets are ash, and their people sleep in the Commons.

triumph.text: The streets rise again within the Year, and the people bless the Houses.

falters.text: The burned-out families drift away to other cities.

calamity.text: The fire spreads again in the Year's end gales, and reaches a House.
